response.overview: What if the one person who truly understands you… is your own reflection?  Jamal, a 16-year-old boy who feels misunderstood, never expects an ordinary moment in front of a mirror to turn into something extraordinary. After accidentally summoning his own reflection, Jamal struggles to believe what he is seeing. But as the unbelievable becomes real, he discovers that this mysterious visitor has something important to tell him.  Will Jamal discover the truth behind his reflection?
response.title: My Reflection
